title: ghatakarpara — ghat-p01-v09
question: Drowned in sorrow-ocean's water; remembrance of your virtue alone keeps her afloat. The rivers' water melts the impurity. Why do you regard me, wretched as I am? Pained by deep cloud-rasa — when, friend, shall I be free of this burning, born of separation from my beloved?
